column2: Lilmoth Dock is about two hundred and fifty paces north-east of here. The walled part of Lilmoth, Lolmoth on the map, is nearly three hundred paces north-north-west. Hereguard Plantation, which Bretons hold, is about three hundred and fifty paces west-north-west.
Wild leeks grow about sixty paces north-north-east of here. Yellow mountain flower grows down by the water, about fifty paces east-south-east.
I sell from this stall, in the village of Flaa Heet. Travellers on the path to the dock buy what the village does not eat: food from the barrels and what the marsh gives.
Flaa Heet leads this village. Three villagers and a child live with him, and two of the villagers sell from stalls.
